entities.summary: Émile Bréhier was a French philosopher. His interest was in classical philosophy, and the history of philosophy. He wrote a Histoire de la Philosophie, translated into English in seven volumes. This work inspired Frederick Copleston's own History of Philosophy (1946–1975), initially comprising nine volumes.

entities.summary: Émile Bréhier was a French philosopher. His interest was in classical philosophy, and the history of philosophy.
